hero.subtitle: Transforming Lives. Empowering Communities.
hero.title: Empower. Enable. Employ.
hero.description: VVK Foundation is a catalyst for change, driving grassroots transformation in Karnataka through targeted initiatives for Farmers, Women, and Youth.

about.title: Who We Are
about.mission_desc: To empower the marginalized sections of society—specifically farmers, women, and youth—by equipping them with the resources, education, and healthcare needed to lead dignified, independent lives.
about.vision_desc: We envision a self-reliant and equitable society where every individual, regardless of their background, has access to opportunities that foster growth, prosperity, and holistic well-being.
about.obj_1: Quality Education: Bridging the gap for rural youth through intensive coaching and mentorship.
about.obj_2: Women's Empowerment: Fostering economic independence and cultural reverence (Nari Shakti).
about.obj_3: Rural Healthcare: Bringing specialized medical camps to underserved communities.
about.obj_4: Agricultural Support: Promoting sustainable farming and farmer welfare.

founder.title: Our Founder
founder.name: Mrs. Veena Vijayanand Kashappanavar
founder.bio: A visionary leader dedicated to social upliftment, Mrs. Veena Kashappanavar has spent years working at the grassroots level. She established the VVK Foundation to institutionalize her efforts in empowering the youth, women, and farmers of the region. Her leadership is marked by compassion, strategic action, and a deep commitment to cultural traditions.
founder.message: "True empowerment begins when we enable others to discover their own strength. At VVK Foundation, our goal is not just to provide aid, but to create sustainable pathways for our youth, our women, and our farmers to thrive independently."
founder.highlight_1: Leading women-centered public events that celebrate dignity, culture, and community participation.
founder.highlight_2: Supporting students through free coaching access and motivational outreach.
founder.highlight_3: Anchoring health and welfare drives in partnership with trusted institutions.

initiatives.title: Our Impact & Initiatives
initiatives.youth_desc: Our free coaching academies for competitive exams (KAS & PSI) have opened doors for hundreds of rural students in the Bagalkot district, ensuring merit-based opportunities for all.
initiatives.women_desc: Through massive 'Nari Shakti' conferences and cultural programs like the Banashankari Jatra, we honor and uplift thousands of women, recognizing their pivotal role in nation-building.
initiatives.health_desc: In collaboration with top institutions like SDM Narayana Hrudayalaya, we organize mega cardiac and general health check-up camps, bringing life-saving care to remote areas.

activities.title: Action on the Ground
activities.act_1_title: Launch of Free KAS & PSI Coaching Academy
activities.act_1_desc: Inaugurated to serve 200 deserving students with entrance exams in Navanagar. Supported by dignitaries and designed to create the next generation of civil servants.
activities.act_2_desc: Over 2,000 mothers and women were honored with the traditional offering (Udi) for Lok Kalyana during a grand cultural gathering.
activities.act_3_desc: Held at Ilkal and Banahatti under the theme 'Nari Shakti Deshada Shakti', honoring women achievers for their resilience and success.
activities.act_4_desc: Marking the founder's birthday, this life-saving camp was executed with SDM Narayana Hrudayalaya in the presence of revered spiritual leaders.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.desc: A visual record of the foundation's community work, celebrations, and public service initiatives.
gallery.section_desc: These photographs are curated from the foundation reports and highlight student outreach, women-led gatherings, health initiatives, and founder-led field engagement.

reports.title: Transparency & Reports
reports.desc: Transparency is core to our mission. Review our detailed annual activity reports.
reports.point_1_desc: The report documents free coaching support for KAS and PSI aspirants, with a focus on rural youth who need merit-based opportunities.
reports.point_2_desc: It captures large-scale women's gatherings, cultural celebrations, and recognition events that reinforce dignity and social participation.
reports.point_3_desc: The foundation report also showcases medical camps and collaborative welfare drives delivered with institutional partners.
reports.card_en_desc: Read the complete English annual report with activity details, photographs, and program summaries.
reports.card_kn_desc: Access the Kannada version of the report for local-language storytelling and community documentation.
reports.gallery_cta_desc: We have also prepared a visual gallery from the report photographs so visitors can quickly explore the foundation's work.
